# Ayman Alawwad

PMO Manager · Portfolio & Program Management
Bridging strategy and execution through portfolio governance.
Ten-plus years leading projects, programs and portfolios across technology, infrastructure, construction and government environments in Saudi Arabia.
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

## Profile
I am a PMO and project/program management professional with more than ten years of experience across portfolio governance, strategic initiatives, technology, infrastructure, construction and government environments in Saudi Arabia.
My work combines hands-on project delivery with portfolio-level governance — bridging strategy and execution, strengthening accountability, improving executive visibility and supporting effective decision-making.
I have managed and delivered projects and portfolios exceeding SAR 500M, working with government stakeholders, executives, multidisciplinary teams and more than 28 suppliers across complex delivery environments.

## Signature figures
- 10+: Years in project, program & portfolio management
- SAR 500M+: Projects and portfolios managed and delivered
- 28+: Suppliers evaluated and approved
- 17+: Cross-functional team members led

## Capabilities
- PMO establishment & governance: Establishing PMO governance frameworks that make accountability, standards and decisions visible. In practice: Launched a Center of Excellence that standardized processes and supported a 3rd-to-1st grade classification upgrade.
- Portfolio & program management: Managing and delivering projects and portfolios exceeding SAR 500M across multiple sectors. In practice: Directed giga-scale infrastructure and technology deployments across 3+ concurrent projects.
- Strategy execution & prioritization: Strategic alignment and prioritization that keep delivery tied to what the organization set out to achieve. In practice: Ensured alignment between business requirements and technical delivery on national-level systems.
- Risk & RAID management: Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies tracked and reported — PMI-RMP® certified. In practice: Monitored risks and maintained risk registers with regular reporting.
- Executive reporting & stakeholders: Executive reporting and stakeholder management with government entities, executives and multidisciplinary teams. In practice: Managed stakeholders across government and private sector entities.
- Vendor & supply governance: Multi-vendor environments managed for performance and compliance. In practice: Evaluated and approved 28+ suppliers; material rejection rates reduced by 40%.

## Governance architecture
- Strategy: Strategic alignment and prioritization
- Portfolio: Portfolio governance and executive reporting
- Program: Program management and cross-functional delivery
- Project: Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery — risk, cost and schedule under control
- Operations: Operational readiness and business value
